Data.title: Domestic Use Table At Basic Prices By Broad Sector, 2022
Data.footnote: This table shows domestically produced products used for intermediate consumption and final demand, valued at basic prices. It also shows income components of value added (compensation of employees, other taxes less subsidies on production, and gross operating surplus) as well as imports of goods and services and taxes less subsidies on products.
